Summary: Remove mjackson2 from the Conditional Access break-glass exclusion group
Description: mjackson2 (standing Global Administrator) was added to the CA07 break-glass exclusion group in error during a prior change (see IAM-117), bypassing MFA enforcement on a live admin account. Remove from the exclusion group and confirm MFA is enforced on next sign-in. Treat as an emergency fix, do not batch with other 0-30 day work.

Summary: Build a mandatory change-management workflow for Conditional Access and privileged role changes
Description: Design and implement a logged workflow for all Conditional Access policy edits and privileged role assignments: named requester, named approver distinct from requester, and a second person who verifies the change was implemented exactly as approved. Root cause of IAM-101, IAM-105, and IAM-107; see findings-summary.md for the full chain.

Summary: Remove bundled Global Administrator grant from the IT Manager onboarding checklist
Description: IT Manager onboarding checklist currently grants standing Global Administrator by default. Replace with role-appropriate baseline access only; any genuine need for tenant-wide admin should be requested separately through IAM-102's workflow once live.

Summary: One-time justification review of all standing Global Administrator accounts
Description: Review wwright, mjackson2, athompson, spatel, and psmith's standing Global Administrator access. Remove or downgrade any grant without a current business justification. Covers the two accounts found in testing (wwright, athompson) plus a full-roster sweep for completeness.

Summary: Establish quarterly attestation for all standing privileged roles
Description: Build a recurring quarterly attestation requirement for every standing privileged role, so an unreviewed grant like athompson's (undiscovered for roughly 3.5 years) cannot persist silently again. Detective control, not preventive; see remediation-plan.md for the accepted trade-off.

Summary: Disable the two orphaned terminated-employee accounts (wnelson, smiller)
Description: wnelson (terminated 2026-09-17) and smiller (terminated 2026-10-12) remain fully Enabled in Entra ID as of the audit date. Disable both accounts immediately and confirm no sign-in activity occurred post-termination.

Summary: Build a daily automated check comparing HRIS terminations against Entra ID account status
Description: Implement a daily job that flags any employee marked Terminated in the HRIS whose Entra ID account is still Enabled, alerting IT & Security same-day. Intended to catch cases like IAM-106 within 24 hours instead of indefinitely.

Summary: Define and enforce a termination-to-disablement SLA with escalation
Description: Set a 3-business-day SLA for disabling an account after termination, with automatic escalation to the IT & Security director if a termination record remains unactioned past that window. nlee's case (16-day gap, no explanation on file) is the motivating example.

Summary: Enroll 11 identified active accounts in MFA
Description: 11 active accounts across 6 departments are not enrolled in MFA despite CA01 requiring it tenant-wide. Full list in 03-testing-evidence/04-mfa-enforcement/workpaper.md. Enroll all 11; two are management-tier accounts (eharris, alewis) and should be prioritized within the batch.

Summary: Audit the MFA auto-enrollment step in new-hire provisioning
Description: Determine why 11 active accounts across 6 departments were never enrolled in MFA despite the documented policy. Treat as a process audit, not 11 unrelated individual oversights, given the spread across departments.

Summary: Rotate svc-backup credential and migrate off legacy authentication
Description: svc-backup still permits legacy (basic) authentication and has not had its password rotated in over a year. Rotate the credential immediately and migrate to certificate-based or managed-identity authentication consistent with the tenant's other service accounts. Test the nightly backup job after migration.

Summary: Right-size svc-hris-sync from Global Administrator to User Administrator
Description: svc-hris-sync only needs to create and update user accounts but holds Global Administrator. Downgrade to User Administrator and rotate its secret, which has never been rotated since the account was created in 2023. Incidental finding, outside the original control matrix.

Summary: Reduce svc-cicd scope to the resource groups its pipelines actually require
Description: svc-cicd holds subscription-level Contributor access with no review since creation. Scope down to the specific resource groups its pipelines touch. Incidental finding, outside the original control matrix.

Summary: Confirm business need for svc-legacy-fileshare or decommission it
Description: svc-legacy-fileshare retains standing SharePoint Administrator rights after the migration project it supported closed in early 2026, with no current business owner. Confirm whether it is still needed; if not, decommission, if so, assign an owner and review its access level. Incidental finding, outside the original control matrix.

Summary: Complete the two outstanding annual access reviews (csanchez, ojackson)
Description: No review evidence found for csanchez or ojackson in the audit period. Complete both reviews and file the evidence.

Summary: Assign a designated secondary access reviewer for single-head departments
Description: Facilities & Admin has no natural secondary reviewer for its department head's own access review. Assign the head's manager (or another designated reviewer) as the standing secondary reviewer for any department with a single-person management layer.

Summary: Reconstruct and correct the change record for the break-glass exclusion group update
Description: The approved change was to add bg-admin2 to the CA07 exclusion group ahead of a scheduled rotation test; mjackson2 was added instead due to a copy-paste error that was never caught or reversed (see IAM-101). Document the corrected record and confirm bg-admin2's intended rotation test still needs to be scheduled.

Summary: Remove ksullivan's retained Engineering repository access
Description: ksullivan transferred from Engineering to IT & Security in 2026-11 but still holds the Engineering-AllRepos group four months later. Remove the retained access.

Summary: Remove swatts' retained access to the People department HR records system
Description: swatts transferred from People to IT & Security roughly a year ago but still holds access to the HR records system, including personal data. Prioritize over IAM-118 given the personal-data exposure and longer duration unaddressed.

Summary: Build an access-recalculation step for HRIS department and role changes
Description: Implement a step triggered by any department or role change in the HRIS that rebuilds the employee's access from their new role's baseline, rather than only adding new access on top of what they already have. Intended to prevent repeats of IAM-118 and IAM-119.

Summary: Correct bcollins' stale manager-of-record field
Description: bcollins transferred from Finance to Legal & Compliance in 2026-12 but still shows their former Finance manager in Entra ID three months later, which also affects who is assigned to review their access under IAM-115/IAM-116. Correct the manager field.

Summary: Add a required approver field to the self-service HRIS onboarding form
Description: The self-service HRIS onboarding form allows account creation with no approver recorded; nmiller2 and bmoore were both created through this path with the approval field left blank. Add a required field so the form cannot submit without a named approver.

Summary: Fix HRIS sync batching to pick up late start-date changes
Description: dtorres' account was not created until 13 days after their hire date because a start-date change made after the initial sync batch was not picked up. Fix the sync logic to re-check pending start-date changes on each run rather than only at the original batch time.

Summary: Test and rotate the overdue break-glass account (bg-admin2)
Description: bg-admin2 has not been successfully tested or rotated since 2025-11-02, over a year past the documented quarterly cadence. Test immediately, rotate the credential, and confirm the account functions correctly for emergency access before closing.
